plugins.description: Two video skills on one engine: narrated explainers (voice as the clock, a mixer for the sound) and beat-cut sizzle reels, drawn in code and rendered with HyperFrames. A studio folder learns the user's look, voice, music and levels with every video; 30 sound effects come free.
